counting: Distinct entity identities and constructor geometry. Exact shape duplicates Dramix and Reyvor excluded. No skin variants counted separately; no claim of 100 modpacks or running 100 mods.
scope: Reusable comparison library for humanoid / semi-humanoid, undead, armored and construct body connections. Not 600 separate references, not a general reference set for birds or quadrupeds.

terracotta_warrior.application: Keep exact six Steve blocks. Topknot, small lamellar shoulder caps, clay face planes, overlapping chest rows; matte clay not shiny bronze. Dark joints support existing punch gait; no invented weapon.

minister.application: Use Steve proportions, modest hat and cuffs. Clean long robe panels, cloth direction, aged distinct face. Heavy monsters are negative proportion comparisons, never transferred to a civilian.
